# What this document does

A `r params$model` BiLSTM trained and tested on **noise-free simulated epidemics**: the curve
is every new infection each day, as the simulator produces it (no reported share, no weekly
pattern, no extra noise). The model reads a window of **any length from
`r params$window_min` to `r params$window_max` days, from the beginning, middle or end** of
an epidemic, and estimates R0 (with ptran) and the state at the start of the window (the
shares `r if (params$model == "SEIR") "exposed, infectious and recovered" else "infectious and recovered"`).

For each window length the report shows:

1. **R0 accuracy** and how often the 95% R0 range holds the true R0;
2. **coverage of the infected counts through time**: from each window's estimates,
   `r params$n_reps` simulations are run forward from the estimated starting state (with
   draws from the R0 range). For every day of the window we check whether the true count is
   inside the 95% band of those simulations, for
   - the **daily new infections** (the curve the model reads), and
   - the **number currently infected** (infectious people; not given to the model).

   Coverage near 95% on every day means the model recovers the epidemic well through the
   whole window.

MODEL   <- params$model
IS_SEIR <- MODEL == "SEIR"
N_SIMS <- params$n_sims; N_DAYS <- params$n_days
WINDOW_MIN <- params$window_min; WINDOW_MAX <- params$window_max; STOP_ZEROS <- params$stop_zeros
EPOCHS <- params$epochs; N_TEST <- params$n_test; N_CALIB <- params$n_calib; K_NB <- params$k_neighbors
N_BAND <- params$n_band_windows; N_REPS <- params$n_reps; MIN_CASES <- params$min_cases
OUT_DIR  <- params$out_dir
BANK_DIR <- if (nzchar(params$bank_dir)) params$bank_dir else file.path(OUT_DIR, "training_bank")
SIM_CORES <- as.integer(params$sim_cores)
SEEDS <- as.integer(params$seeds); ENSEMBLE <- isTRUE(params$ensemble) && length(SEEDS) > 1
RETRAIN <- isTRUE(params$retrain)
BANK_SEED <- 122; TEST_SEED <- 2025; CALIB_SEED <- 7

KNOWN   <- if (IS_SEIR) c("n", "recov", "incub") else c("n", "recov")
TARGETS <- c("ptran", "R0")
STATES  <- if (IS_SEIR) c("exposed_share", "infected_share", "recovered_share") else c("infected_share", "recovered_share")
EPI_STATES <- c(exposed_share = "Exposed", infected_share = "Infected", recovered_share = "Recovered")[STATES]
STATE_TARGETS <- paste0("log_", STATES)
STATE_OFFSET  <- 1e-4   # log(share + 1e-4): shares can be 0; 1e-4 is half a person in 5,000
OUTPUT_ACTIVATION   <- c("sigmoid", "softplus", rep("sigmoid", length(STATES)))
INCIDENCE_MAX       <- 10000
INCIDENCE_TRANSFORM <- "log1p"

# Same ranges as the v6 models (without the reporting part). The share
# initially infected (SIR) or exposed (SEIR) is drawn on the log scale.
PRIORS <- if (IS_SEIR) {
  list(n = c(5000, 10000), recov = c(0.071, 0.25), crate = c(5, 15), incub = c(1, 21), R0 = c(0.8, 5),

} else {
  list(n = c(5000, 10000), recov = c(0.071, 0.25), crate = c(1, 5), R0 = c(0.8, 5), preval = c(0.001, 0.4))
}

hp <- jsonlite::read_json(params$hyperparameters)
LEARNING_RATE <- hp$learning_rate; BATCH_SIZE <- as.integer(hp$batch_size); HIDDEN_SIZE <- as.integer(hp$hidden_size)
NUM_LAYERS <- as.integer(hp$num_layers); DROPOUT <- hp$dropout; GRAD_CLIP <- params$grad_clip
LR_SCHEDULE <- params$lr_schedule

GRID_LENGTHS <- c(30, 61, 90, 120, 180, 270, 365)

# Step 1: simulate

```{r simulate}
# Days before the first run of k days without cases (the whole curve if none).
informative_days <- function(curve, k = STOP_ZEROS) {
  r   <- rle(as.numeric(curve) == 0)
  hit <- which(r$values & r$lengths >= k)[1]
  if (is.na(hit)) length(curve) else sum(r$lengths[seq_len(hit)]) - r$lengths[hit]
}

# Run the epiworldR model for L days from a starting state and return the daily
# new infections and the shares in each state at the start of each day. A fresh
# epidemic starts with `preval` exposed (SEIR) or infected (SIR).
run_model <- function(p, L, seed) {
  get <- function(x, default) if (is.null(x)) default else x
  if (IS_SEIR) {
    E <- get(p$exposed_share, p$preval); I <- get(p$infected_share, 0); R <- get(p$recovered_share, 0)
    carriers <- E + I
    m <- epiworldR::ModelSEIRCONN(name = "sim", n = p$n, prevalence = carriers, contact_rate = p$crate,
                                  incubation_days = p$incub, transmission_rate = p$ptran, recovery_rate = p$recov)
    if (I > 0 || R > 0) epiworldR::initial_states(m, c(if (carriers > 0) I / carriers else 0, R / (1 - carriers)))
    epiworldR::verbose_off(m)
    epiworldR::run(m, ndays = L + 1L, seed = seed)
  } else {
    I <- get(p$infected_share, p$preval); R <- get(p$recovered_share, 0)
    m <- epiworldR::ModelSIRCONN(name = "sim", n = p$n, prevalence = I, contact_rate = p$crate,
                                 transmission_rate = p$ptran, recovery_rate = p$recov)
    if (R > 0) epiworldR::initial_states(m, R / (1 - I))
    epiworldR::verbose_off(m)
    epiworldR::run(m, ndays = L, seed = seed)
  }
  h <- epiworldR::get_hist_total(m)
  h <- h[order(h$date), ]
  at_start <- function(state) {
    x <- h$counts[h$state == state] / p$n
    c(x, rep(x[length(x)], L))[seq_len(L)]
  }
  list(incidence = get_incidence(m, L, keep_day_zero = FALSE),
       states = vapply(EPI_STATES, at_start, numeric(L)))
}

simulate_states <- function(n_sims, seed) {
  base <- if (IS_SEIR) seir_simulator(ndays = N_DAYS, priors = PRIORS) else
    sir_simulator(ndays = N_DAYS, priors = PRIORS, keep_day_zero = FALSE)
  sampler <- if (IS_SEIR) base$sample_parameters else function(n_sims) {
    th <- base$sample_parameters(n_sims)
    th$initial_infected <- pmax(1, round(log_uniform(n_sims, PRIORS$preval) * th$n))
    th$preval <- th$initial_infected / th$n
    th
  }
  sim <- new_simulator(sampler, function(parameters, seed) {
    out <- run_model(parameters, N_DAYS, seed)
    c(out$incidence, as.vector(out$states))
  }, type = MODEL)
  simulate_training_data(sim, n_sims = n_sims, seed = seed)
}

simulate_bank <- function(n_keep, seed) {
  n_draw <- ceiling(1.15 * n_keep)
  sizes  <- diff(round(seq(0, n_draw, length.out = max(SIM_CORES, 1) + 1)))
  chunks <- parallel::mclapply(seq_along(sizes), function(k) simulate_states(sizes[k], seed + k - 1),
                               mc.cores = max(SIM_CORES, 1))
  failed <- vapply(chunks, inherits, logical(1), what = "try-error")
  if (any(failed)) stop("Simulation chunk(s) failed: ", paste(which(failed), collapse = ", "))
  theta <- do.call(rbind, lapply(chunks, `[[`, "theta"))
  part  <- function(j) do.call(rbind, lapply(chunks, function(x) x$observations[, j * N_DAYS + seq_len(N_DAYS), drop = FALSE]))
  cases  <- part(0)
  states <- setNames(lapply(seq_along(STATES), part), STATES)
  rm(chunks)
  keep <- which(rowSums(cases) >= MIN_CASES)
  if (length(keep) < n_keep) stop("Only ", length(keep), " epidemics with enough cases.")
  keep <- keep[seq_len(n_keep)]
  theta <- theta[keep, ]
  rownames(theta) <- NULL
  list(theta = theta, cases = cases[keep, , drop = FALSE], states = lapply(states, function(s) s[keep, , drop = FALSE]),
       dropped_share = mean(rowSums(cases) < MIN_CASES))
}

prefix <- tolower(MODEL)
write_matrix <- function(x, file) data.table::fwrite(as.data.frame(round(x, 5)), file)
train_files <- c(theta = file.path(BANK_DIR, paste0(prefix, "_theta.csv")),
                 cases = file.path(BANK_DIR, paste0(prefix, "_observations.csv")),
                 setNames(file.path(BANK_DIR, paste0(prefix, "_", STATE_TARGETS, ".csv")), STATE_TARGETS))

fresh_bank <- FALSE
if (!all(file.exists(train_files)) || nrow(data.table::fread(train_files[["theta"]], select = 1L)) != N_SIMS) {
  t_sim <- system.time(b <- simulate_bank(N_SIMS, BANK_SEED))
  dir.create(BANK_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  data.table::fwrite(b$theta, train_files[["theta"]])
  write_matrix(b$cases, train_files[["cases"]])
  for (k in seq_along(STATES)) write_matrix(log(b$states[[k]] + STATE_OFFSET), train_files[[STATE_TARGETS[k]]])
  writeLines(as.character(c(round(t_sim[["elapsed"]]), b$dropped_share)),
             file.path(BANK_DIR, "simulation_seconds_and_dropped_share.txt"))
  rm(b); gc()
  fresh_bank <- TRUE
}

test_file  <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "test_bank.rds")
calib_file <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "calibration_windows.rds")
if (!file.exists(test_file)) saveRDS(simulate_bank(N_TEST, TEST_SEED), test_file)
if (!file.exists(calib_file)) {
  b <- simulate_bank(N_CALIB, CALIB_SEED)
  set.seed(CALIB_SEED)
  active <- apply(b$cases, 1, informative_days)
  use <- which(active >= WINDOW_MIN)
  L <- vapply(use, function(i) if (min(WINDOW_MAX, active[i]) == WINDOW_MIN) WINDOW_MIN else
    sample(WINDOW_MIN:min(WINDOW_MAX, active[i]), 1), numeric(1))
  s <- vapply(seq_along(use), function(j) sample.int(active[use[j]] - L[j] + 1, 1), numeric(1))
  saveRDS(list(theta = b$theta[use, ], start = s, length = L,
               cases = lapply(seq_along(use), function(j) b$cases[use[j], s[j]:(s[j] + L[j] - 1)]),
               state = data.frame(lapply(b$states, function(m) m[cbind(use, s)]))), calib_file)
  rm(b); gc()
}
test  <- readRDS(test_file)
calib <- readRDS(calib_file)
info  <- readLines(file.path(BANK_DIR, "simulation_seconds_and_dropped_share.txt"))
active <- apply(test$cases, 1, informative_days)
cat("Training bank:", format(N_SIMS, big.mark = ","), "epidemics, simulated in", round(as.numeric(info[1]) / 60, 1),
    "minutes;", sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * as.numeric(info[2])), "dropped (fewer than", MIN_CASES, "cases)\n")
cat("Test epidemics: days before the first week without new infections\n")
print(summary(active))
```

# Step 2: train

```{r train}
model_dirs <- file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0("model_seed_", SEEDS))
model_matches <- function(dir, seed) {
  f <- file.path(dir, "model_config.json")
  if (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "model.pt")) || !file.exists(f)) return(FALSE)
  cfg <- jsonlite::read_json(f)
  cfg$epochs == EPOCHS && cfg$seed == seed && isTRUE(cfg$variable_length) && !isTRUE(cfg$observation_noise) &&
    cfg$window_min == WINDOW_MIN && cfg$window_max == WINDOW_MAX && cfg$window_stop_zeros == STOP_ZEROS &&
    identical(unlist(cfg$target_names), c(TARGETS, STATE_TARGETS)) &&
    cfg$hidden_size == HIDDEN_SIZE && cfg$batch_size == BATCH_SIZE && isTRUE(all.equal(cfg$learning_rate, LEARNING_RATE)) &&
    identical(if (is.null(cfg$lr_schedule)) "none" else cfg$lr_schedule, LR_SCHEDULE)
}
for (i in seq_along(SEEDS)) {
  if (RETRAIN || fresh_bank || !model_matches(model_dirs[i], SEEDS[i])) {
    t <- system.time(train_bilstm_calibrator(
      name = prefix, known_names = KNOWN, target_names = TARGETS, type = MODEL,
      parameter_file = train_files[["theta"]], observation_file = train_files[["cases"]],
      output_dir = model_dirs[i], epochs = EPOCHS, batch_size = BATCH_SIZE, learning_rate = LEARNING_RATE,
      seed = SEEDS[i], hidden_size = HIDDEN_SIZE, num_layers = NUM_LAYERS, dropout = DROPOUT,
      physics_weight = 0, incidence_max = INCIDENCE_MAX, incidence_transform = INCIDENCE_TRANSFORM,
      output_activation = OUTPUT_ACTIVATION, window_min = WINDOW_MIN, window_max = WINDOW_MAX,
      window_stop_zeros = STOP_ZEROS, state_files = train_files[STATE_TARGETS], grad_clip = GRAD_CLIP,
      lr_schedule = LR_SCHEDULE, resume = isTRUE(params$resume),
      device = params$device
    ))
    writeLines(as.character(round(t[["elapsed"]])), file.path(model_dirs[i], "training_seconds.txt"))
  }
}
knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(SEEDS), function(i) {
  cfg <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(model_dirs[i], "model_config.json"))
  data.frame(seed = SEEDS[i], best_epoch = cfg$best_epoch, trained_on = cfg$device,
             minutes = round(as.numeric(readLines(file.path(model_dirs[i], "training_seconds.txt"))) / 60))
})), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Step 3: R0 by window length and position

Windows of each length at the beginning, middle and end of each test epidemic's days with
cases (before its first week without new infections).

```{r predict}
predict_models <- function(dirs, curves, known) {
  known <- as.data.frame(known)[, KNOWN, drop = FALSE]
  ests  <- lapply(dirs, function(d) bilstm_predict_many(d, curves, known, device = params$device))
  avg   <- Reduce(`+`, ests) / length(ests)
  avg$crate <- avg$R0 * known$recov / avg$ptran
  for (s in STATES) avg[[s]] <- pmax(avg[[s]] - STATE_OFFSET, 0)
  avg
}
DIRS  <- if (ENSEMBLE) model_dirs else model_dirs[1]
LABEL <- if (ENSEMBLE) sprintf("%s (average of %d seeds)", MODEL, length(SEEDS)) else MODEL

win_start <- function(pos, L, a) switch(pos, beginning = 1, middle = floor((a - L) / 2) + 1, end = a - L + 1)
grid <- expand.grid(length = GRID_LENGTHS, position = POSITIONS, curve = seq_len(N_TEST), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
grid <- grid[active[grid$curve] >= grid$length, ]
grid$start <- mapply(win_start, grid$position, grid$length, active[grid$curve])
windows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(k) test$cases[grid$curve[k], grid$start[k]:(grid$start[k] + grid$length[k] - 1)])
known_g <- test$theta[grid$curve, ]
est <- predict_models(DIRS, windows, known_g)
grid$R0_true <- test$theta$R0[grid$curve]
grid$R0_est  <- est$R0
grid$R0_abs_error <- abs(grid$R0_est - grid$R0_true)

r0_tab <- aggregate(R0_abs_error ~ length + position, grid, mean)
n_tab  <- aggregate(R0_abs_error ~ length + position, grid, length)
write.csv(r0_tab, file.path(OUT_DIR, "R0_MAE_by_length_and_position.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
w <- reshape(r0_tab, idvar = "length", timevar = "position", direction = "wide")
names(w) <- sub("R0_abs_error.", "", names(w), fixed = TRUE)
wn <- reshape(n_tab, idvar = "length", timevar = "position", direction = "wide")
w$windows <- rowSums(wn[match(w$length, wn$length), -1], na.rm = TRUE)
knitr::kable(w[order(w$length), c("length", intersect(POSITIONS, names(w)), "windows")], digits = 3, row.names = FALSE,
             caption = paste(LABEL, ": R0 mean absolute error by window length and position"))
```

```{r r0-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=4.5}
cols <- c(beginning = "black", middle = "blue", end = "red")
plot(NA, xlim = range(GRID_LENGTHS), ylim = c(0, max(r0_tab$R0_abs_error)), xlab = "window length (days)",
     ylab = "R0 mean absolute error", main = paste(MODEL, ": R0 accuracy by window length (noise-free data)"))
for (p in POSITIONS) {
  g <- r0_tab[r0_tab$position == p, ]
  lines(g$length, g$R0_abs_error, type = "b", pch = 16, lwd = 2, col = cols[p])
}
legend("topright", bty = "n", lwd = 2, col = cols, legend = POSITIONS)
```

The other outputs over all test windows (ptran next to the best guess when R0 is known
exactly; only R0 = ptran x crate / recov shapes a curve):

```{r other-outputs}
r2 <- function(e, t) 1 - sum((e - t)^2) / sum((t - mean(t))^2)
th <- test$theta[grid$curve, ]
st_true <- data.frame(lapply(test$states, function(m) m[cbind(grid$curve, grid$start)]))
best_ptran <- th$R0 * th$recov * log(PRIORS$crate[2] / PRIORS$crate[1]) / diff(PRIORS$crate)
lg <- function(x) log(x + STATE_OFFSET)
out_tab <- data.frame(
  output = c("R0", "ptran", "ptran: best guess knowing R0", paste("log share", sub("_share", "", STATES), "at window start")),
  MAE = c(mean(abs(est$R0 - th$R0)), mean(abs(est$ptran - th$ptran)), mean(abs(best_ptran - th$ptran)),
          vapply(STATES, function(s) mean(abs(lg(est[[s]]) - lg(st_true[[s]]))), 0)),
  R2 = c(r2(est$R0, th$R0), r2(est$ptran, th$ptran), r2(best_ptran, th$ptran),
         vapply(STATES, function(s) r2(lg(est[[s]]), lg(st_true[[s]])), 0))
)
write.csv(out_tab, file.path(OUT_DIR, "all_outputs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(out_tab, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
```

## The 95% R0 range

For each window, the `r K_NB` calibration windows with the most similar estimates (and
similar known values and length) show how far the truth falls from the estimate; their
errors give the R0 range and the parameter draws for the simulations below.

```{r calibration}
calib_est <- predict_models(DIRS, calib$cases, calib$theta)
features <- function(e, known, L) {
  st  <- matrix(sapply(STATES, function(s) lg(e[[s]])), nrow = nrow(e), dimnames = list(NULL, STATES))
  out <- cbind(R0 = e$R0, st, recov = known$recov, lL = log(L))
  if (IS_SEIR) out <- cbind(out, incub = known$incub)
  out
}
F_cal <- features(calib_est, calib$theta, calib$length)
F_mu <- colMeans(F_cal); F_sd <- apply(F_cal, 2, sd)
F_t  <- t(scale(F_cal, F_mu, F_sd))
resid <- data.frame(R0 = calib$theta$R0 - calib_est$R0,
                    sapply(STATES, function(s) lg(calib$state[[s]]) - lg(calib_est[[s]])))
neighbours <- function(e, known, L) {
  f <- (features(e, known, L)[1, ] - F_mu) / F_sd
  d <- colSums((F_t - f)^2)
  which(d <= sort(d, partial = K_NB)[K_NB])[seq_len(K_NB)]
}
r0_range <- function(e, nb) e$R0 + quantile(resid$R0[nb], c(0.025, 0.975), names = FALSE)

# Parameter draws: the estimate plus the errors of one similar calibration window
# each (R0 and the starting state together); shares above 95% in total are scaled down.
draw_parameters <- function(e, known, nb, n) {
  j  <- sample(nb, n, replace = TRUE)
  R0 <- pmax(0.05, e$R0 + resid$R0[j])
  sh <- sapply(STATES, function(s) pmax(exp(lg(e[[s]]) + resid[[s]][j]) - STATE_OFFSET, 0))
  sh <- sh * pmin(1, 0.95 / pmax(rowSums(sh), 1e-12))
  data.frame(n = known$n, recov = known$recov, incub = if (IS_SEIR) known$incub else NA,
             ptran = e$ptran, crate = R0 * known$recov / e$ptran, sh)
}

set.seed(3)
check <- sample(nrow(grid), min(5000, nrow(grid)))
rng <- t(vapply(check, function(k) r0_range(est[k, ], neighbours(est[k, ], known_g[k, ], grid$length[k])), numeric(2)))
inside <- grid$R0_true[check] >= rng[, 1] & grid$R0_true[check] <= rng[, 2]
range_tab <- aggregate(cbind(inside = 100 * inside, width = rng[, 2] - rng[, 1]) ~ length, data.frame(length = grid$length[check]), mean)
range_tab <- rbind(range_tab, data.frame(length = "all", inside = 100 * mean(inside), width = mean(rng[, 2] - rng[, 1])))
names(range_tab) <- c("window length", "true R0 inside the 95% range (%)", "mean width")
write.csv(range_tab, file.path(OUT_DIR, "R0_range_check.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(range_tab, digits = 2, row.names = FALSE)
```

# Step 4: coverage of infected counts through time

Up to `r N_BAND` test windows for each length and position. For each window,
`r N_REPS` simulations start from the estimated state on its first day, with R0 and the
starting state drawn from the model's range, and run for the window's length. On each day
of the window we check whether the true count is inside the 95% band (2.5% to 97.5% of the
simulations).

```{r coverage}
set.seed(4)
pick <- unlist(lapply(split(seq_len(nrow(grid)), paste(grid$length, grid$position)),
                      function(k) if (length(k) > N_BAND) sample(k, N_BAND) else k))
cov_file <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "coverage_windows.rds")
if (file.exists(cov_file)) {
  cov <- readRDS(cov_file)
} else {
  cov <- parallel::mclapply(pick, function(k) {
    set.seed(k)
    L <- grid$length[k]; i <- grid$curve[k]; s <- grid$start[k]
    e <- est[k, ]; known <- known_g[k, ]
    draws <- draw_parameters(e, known, neighbours(e, known, L), N_REPS)
    sims <- lapply(seq_len(N_REPS), function(r) run_model(as.list(draws[r, ]), L, seed = r))
    inc  <- vapply(sims, `[[`, numeric(L), "incidence")
    infd <- vapply(sims, function(x) x$states[, "infected_share"] * known$n, numeric(L))
    true_inc  <- test$cases[i, s:(s + L - 1)]
    true_infd <- test$states$infected_share[i, s:(s + L - 1)] * known$n
    band <- function(x) apply(x, 1, quantile, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
    bi <- band(inc); bp <- band(infd)
    list(k = k, length = L, position = grid$position[k],
         in_inc = true_inc >= bi[1, ] & true_inc <= bi[3, ],
         in_infd = true_infd >= bp[1, ] & true_infd <= bp[3, ],
         width_inc = bi[3, ] - bi[1, ], width_infd = bp[3, ] - bp[1, ],
         true_inc = true_inc, true_infd = true_infd, band_inc = bi, band_infd = bp)
  }, mc.cores = max(SIM_CORES, 1))
  saveRDS(cov, cov_file)
}
cov_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cov, function(x) data.frame(length = x$length, position = x$position,
  new_infections = 100 * mean(x$in_inc), currently_infected = 100 * mean(x$in_infd))))
cov_sum <- aggregate(cbind(new_infections, currently_infected) ~ length + position, cov_tab, mean)
cov_sum$windows <- aggregate(new_infections ~ length + position, cov_tab, length)$new_infections
cov_sum <- cov_sum[order(cov_sum$length, match(cov_sum$position, POSITIONS)), ]
write.csv(cov_sum, file.path(OUT_DIR, "coverage_by_length_and_position.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(cov_sum, digits = 1, row.names = FALSE,
             col.names = c("length", "position", "coverage %: new infections", "coverage %: currently infected", "windows"),
             caption = "Share of days (all days of all windows) where the true count is inside the 95% band")
```

## Through time

For each window length, the coverage on each day of the window (the share of windows
whose true count is inside the band on that day).

```{r coverage-by-day}
by_day <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(cov, paste(vapply(cov, `[[`, 0, "length"), vapply(cov, `[[`, "", "position"))),
  function(xs) {
    L <- xs[[1]]$length
    data.frame(length = L, position = xs[[1]]$position, day = seq_len(L),
               new_infections = 100 * rowMeans(matrix(sapply(xs, `[[`, "in_inc"), nrow = L)),
               currently_infected = 100 * rowMeans(matrix(sapply(xs, `[[`, "in_infd"), nrow = L)),
               windows = length(xs))
  }))
write.csv(by_day, file.path(OUT_DIR, "coverage_by_day.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r coverage-by-day-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=7, results="asis"}
for (what in c("new_infections", "currently_infected")) {
  cat("\n\n### ", if (what == "new_infections") "Daily new infections" else "Number currently infected", "\n\n", sep = "")
  lens <- sort(unique(by_day$length))
  op <- par(mfrow = c(2, 4), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))
  for (L in lens) {
    plot(NA, xlim = c(1, L), ylim = c(0, 100), xlab = "day of the window", ylab = "coverage %",
         main = sprintf("%d-day windows", L))
    abline(h = 95, lty = 2, col = "grey50")
    for (p in POSITIONS) {
      g <- by_day[by_day$length == L & by_day$position == p, ]
      if (nrow(g)) lines(g$day, stats::filter(g[[what]], rep(1 / 3, 3), sides = 2), col = cols[p], lwd = 2)
    }
  }
  plot.new(); legend("center", bty = "n", lwd = 2, col = c(cols, "grey50"), lty = c(1, 1, 1, 2),
                     legend = c(paste(POSITIONS, "of the epidemic"), "95%"))
  par(op)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

(Lines smoothed over 3 days.)

## Examples

```{r examples, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
set.seed(5)
ex <- unlist(lapply(c(30, 90, 180, 365), function(L) {
  k <- which(vapply(cov, `[[`, 0, "length") == L & vapply(cov, `[[`, "", "position") == "beginning")
  if (length(k)) k[sample.int(length(k), 1)]
}))
ex <- c(ex, unlist(lapply(c("middle", "end"), function(p) {
  k <- which(vapply(cov, `[[`, 0, "length") == 90 & vapply(cov, `[[`, "", "position") == p)
  if (length(k)) k[sample.int(length(k), 1)]
})))
op <- par(mfrow = c(length(ex), 2), mar = c(3, 4, 2.5, 1))
for (j in ex) {
  x <- cov[[j]]
  for (what in c("inc", "infd")) {
    b <- x[[paste0("band_", what)]]; y <- x[[paste0("true_", what)]]; d <- seq_along(y)
    plot(d, y, type = "n", ylim = range(c(y, b)), xlab = "", ylab = if (what == "inc") "new infections" else "currently infected",
         main = sprintf("%d days, %s: %s (coverage %.0f%%)", x$length, x$position,
                        if (what == "inc") "new infections" else "currently infected",
                        100 * mean(x[[paste0("in_", what)]])), cex.main = 0.9)
    polygon(c(d, rev(d)), c(b[3, ], rev(b[1, ])), col = adjustcolor("forestgreen", 0.3), border = NA)
    lines(d, b[2, ], col = "forestgreen", lwd = 2)
    lines(d, y, col = "blue", lwd = 1.5)
  }
}
par(op)
```

Blue: the true counts. Green: median and 95% band of the simulations from the model's estimates.

# Summary

```{r summary}
summary_tab <- data.frame(
  length = GRID_LENGTHS,
  R0_MAE_beginning = r0_tab$R0_abs_error[match(paste(GRID_LENGTHS, "beginning"), paste(r0_tab$length, r0_tab$position))],
  R0_MAE_all_positions = vapply(GRID_LENGTHS, function(L) mean(grid$R0_abs_error[grid$length == L]), 0),
  R0_in_95_range = as.numeric(range_tab[match(GRID_LENGTHS, range_tab[[1]]), 2]),
  coverage_new_infections = vapply(GRID_LENGTHS, function(L) mean(cov_tab$new_infections[cov_tab$length == L]), 0),
  coverage_currently_infected = vapply(GRID_LENGTHS, function(L) mean(cov_tab$currently_infected[cov_tab$length == L]), 0)
)
summary_tab <- summary_tab[is.finite(summary_tab$R0_MAE_all_positions), ]
write.csv(summary_tab, file.path(OUT_DIR, "summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(summary_tab, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE,
             col.names = c("window length", "R0 MAE (beginning)", "R0 MAE (all positions)", "true R0 in 95% range (%)",
                           "coverage %: new infections", "coverage %: currently infected"))
```

saveRDS(list(settings = settings, r0 = r0_tab, outputs = out_tab, R0_range = range_tab,
             coverage = cov_sum, coverage_by_day = by_day, summary = summary_tab, params = params),
